content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the GNDU Junior Technician Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of GNDU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GNDU Junior Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for online application submission for the GNDU Junior Technician recruitment is 11 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree or a three-year diploma in a relevant subject from a recognized institution. Additionally, proficiency in Punjabi up to the Matriculation standard is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for the GNDU Junior Technician post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 944/- (including GST) for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 472/- (including GST) for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Technician position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 19900/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Technician post in Guru Nanak Dev University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Technician role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Punjabi Language Test, a Written Test, and a Practical Test.

faq.question: Q7. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for the GNDU Junior Technician recruitment starts on 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Guru Nanak Dev University?
faq.answer: The official website of Guru Nanak Dev University is https://digital.gndu.ac.in.
